item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows four objects Nikhil labels P, Q, R and S: the Sun, a glowing lamp, a book, and the Moon.

Which claim about luminous and non-luminous objects is correct?

options.A: P and Q are luminous because they emit their own light; R and S are non-luminous.
options.B: P, Q and S are luminous because they look bright; R is non-luminous.
options.C: Only P is luminous; Q, R and S are non-luminous.
options.D: R is luminous because a book can be seen in daylight.
